pokemon: The very first Pokémon ever designed was Rhydon — not Pikachu!
Pikachu's name mixes 'pika' (a spark sound) and 'chu' (a mouse squeak).
There are now over 1,000 different Pokémon species.
Magikarp can barely do anything… until it evolves into mighty Gyarados.
Ditto can transform into a copy of almost any other Pokémon.
Eevee has more evolutions than any other Pokémon — eight of them!
Snorlax weighs about 1,000 pounds and loves to nap anywhere.
Mewtwo was created from the DNA of the rare Pokémon Mew.
Slowpoke can lose its tail and simply grow a new one.
Mr. Mime can build invisible walls out of thin air.
Farfetch'd carries a leek (a green onion) around like a little sword.
Wailord is the tallest Pokémon, but it's surprisingly light and floaty.
A 'shiny' Pokémon is a super-rare version with different colors.
Pokémon was inspired by its creator's childhood love of catching bugs.
Psyduck's constant headache is what powers its psychic attacks.
Wobbuffet hides its real face — its black tail — and keeps it secret.
Some Pokémon, like Shedinja, have only 1 HP.
Arcanine was almost made a Legendary Pokémon.
The first games, Red and Green, came out in Japan back in 1996.
Gengar is sometimes called Clefable's shadow because of their similar shapes.
Wartortle's tail is said to get darker the older and wiser it gets.
Machamp has four arms and can throw 1,000 punches in two seconds.
Lapras can carry people across the sea on its back.
Cubone wears the skull of its lost mother as a helmet.
Pichu can accidentally shock itself when it uses electricity.
kirby: Kirby can inhale his enemies and copy their powers!
Kirby is only about 8 inches tall — smaller than a school ruler.
Kirby's home is a star-shaped planet called Popstar.
Kirby was created by Masahiro Sakurai when he was just 19 years old.
Kirby floats by swallowing a big gulp of air and puffing up.
In his first US game, Kirby was pale — Japan always knew he was pink!
Kirby first appeared in 'Kirby's Dream Land' in 1992.
King Dedede is Kirby's big, hammer-swinging rival.
Meta Knight looks a lot like Kirby underneath his mask.
Kirby rides a shooting star called the Warp Star.
Kirby can copy more than 25 different abilities in some games.
Waddle Dees are the round little helpers you see all over Dream Land.
Kirby was almost replaced by a fancier character, but the team loved him.
Kirby has starred in kart racing, pinball, and even painting games.
Kirby's happy-go-lucky smile makes him one of Nintendo's friendliest heroes.
When Kirby copies an enemy, he often gets a fun new hat to match.
Kirby can turn into a giant wheel to zoom around super fast.
Kirby's tummy seems endless — he can inhale almost anything!
The name 'Kirby' may come from a lawyer named John Kirby.
Whispy Woods, a grumpy apple-dropping tree, is often the first boss.
Kirby has saved Dream Land dozens of times across his games.
Kirby can share his powers with friends in some newer adventures.
Kirby's 'Star Rod' is a legendary item that keeps Dream Land dreaming.
minecraft: Minecraft is the best-selling video game of all time.
Creepers were created by accident — a mistake while coding a pig!
When a creeper starts hissing, run — it's about to explode.
Endermen get angry if you look straight at them.
Netherite is even tougher than diamond.
One full day in Minecraft lasts about 20 real-world minutes.
The Ender Dragon is the game's giant final boss.
Cats scare creepers away, so they make great pets for your house.
Endermen 'talk' in creepy, backwards, distorted English.
Minecraft was first made by Markus 'Notch' Persson in 2009.
Slimes split into smaller slimes each time you hit them.
Bees pollinate flowers and make honey in their hives.
You can hatch baby chickens by throwing eggs.
Diamonds hide deep underground, usually near lava — be careful!
The Nether is a dangerous, fiery other dimension.
Villagers will trade useful items with you for emeralds.
A single block is about one cubic meter in the game world.
Pink sheep are a rare surprise when sheep spawn.
You can grow mushrooms so big you can walk under them.
Wolves can be tamed with bones and become loyal dogs.
The rare 'Mooshroom' is a red cow covered in mushrooms.
Redstone works like electrical wiring to build machines.
Sleeping in a bed skips the night and sets your respawn point.
The Warden is a powerful blind mob that hunts by sound.
You can ride a pig if you put a saddle on it and hold a carrot.
